notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Achievement Fix[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused "Die x Times Achievements" not being registered
[*] Fixed a bug that didn't bring out developer comments upon death. 
[*] Added One extra achievement on passing the lava stage
[*] Enabled Video settings
[*] Removed Controls Settings entirely(Engine limitation)
[*] Added new bugs to be fixed later
[/list]


Note : Due to engine limitations we are unable to give players to customize keybindings for now.

notes.title: Bug issue
notes.content: We have been made aware of the death achievements not working. We will be fixing the issue as soon as possible. Thanks for being patient.

notes.title: Linux Release
notes.content: As of today we are releasing the game for Linux. We got a very positive feedback for the game so far. And we saw a lot of linux wish listing.

notes.title: Developers Announcement
notes.content:
A Roll-Back Story will be released by the next 24 hrs. I'd like to thank everyone who gave us their precious feedback through the development phase. We did our best to ensure that the game is bug free when it's released.

We will do our best to release the game on Mac and Linux in the upcoming weeks.

I hope you all have a blast playing the game.

notes.title: Bug Issues
notes.content:
As of today beta testers have access to the game. We tried our best to minimize the bugs.But it's not possible to find and fix every bug. We would take note from beta testers review and do our best to have the game bug free before release.
Thank you for playing

notes.title: Developer's Announcement
notes.content:
Well I really wanted to get the game out on the steam market as soon as possible. I thought I better get the feedback from the community. The demo doesn't have any audio on it because we don't really have any full time audio manager. We are trying to Crowdfund the game thru Kick-Starter. So in case you see potential in the game Do give us support through Kick-Starter.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1329845603/a-roll-back-story

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33032503/0ac0c89544859ebf652e4106699d325cb97b7caf.png[/img]

notes.title: Community Collaboration
notes.content: I think the gameplay idea is pretty clear from the demo. Now to work with the community I came up with a great idea. I'll have a few secret levels designed by the community. Those won't affect the Main story but Those will be included. Now if you are interested all you need to do is make a sketch of the level. Give a detail of how the level should work(such as interactions or traps) and make a public tweet with hastag #RollBack_Community_Design. Make sure I can contact you from your tweet.
